tools.name: get_trending
tools.description: Trending TikTok videos, hashtags and sounds breaking out right now, optionally filtered to a niche. Ranked by view velocity over real public data. Without an API key: a 5-result preview.

tools.name: get_outliers
tools.description: TikTok videos beating their own creator's usual views by the widest margin (the real breakouts), optionally for a niche or free-text search. Each result includes the outlier multiple and the creator's baseline (Pro and Agency keys; otherwise a 5-result preview without them).

tools.name: get_trending_hashtags
tools.description: The TikTok hashtags recurring most under what is breaking out right now, optionally for a niche. Without an API key: the top 10.
